arxiv-1609-00882.description: Abstract The perspective of Kac–Schwarz operators is introduced to the authors’ previous work on the quantum mirror curves of topological string theory in strip geometry and closed topological vertex. arxiv-2203-05745.title: Implementing Optimization-Based Control Tasks in Cyber–Physical Systems With Limited Computing Capacity
arxiv-2203-05745.creator: Mehdi Hosseinzadeh, Bruno Sinopoli, Ilya Kolmanovsky, Sanjoy Baruah
arxiv-2203-05745.description: Abstract I Introduction and Motivation A common aspect of today’s Cyber–Physical Systems (CPSs) is that multiple control tasks may execute in a shared processor. For a CPS performing n optimization-based control tasks, denoted by \tau_{k},~k={1,\cdots,n} , let \ell_{k} and \Delta T_{k} denote the worst-case execution time and sampling period of task \tau_{k} , respectively.

arxiv-2212-14125.title: MuTable (Music Table): Turn any surface into musical instrument
arxiv-2212-14125.creator: Ragini Gupta, Akash Mittal
arxiv-2212-14125.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ragini Gupta, Akash Mittal. Abstract With the rise in pervasive computing solutions, interactive surfaces have gained a large popularity across multi-application domains including smart boards for education, touch-enabled kiosks for smart retail and smart mirrors for smart homes. Despite the increased popularity of such interactive surfaces, existing platforms are mostly limited to custom built surfaces with attached sensors and hardware, that are expensive and require complicated design considerations.

Scientific results from data presented in this publication ar
arxiv-2306-01617.creator: Rebecca Lin, Marten H. van Kerkwijk, Franz Kirsten, Ue-Li Pen, Adam T. Deller
arxiv-2306-01617.description: Abstract We use four observations with the European VLBI network to measure the first precise radio parallax of the Crab Pulsar. We found two in-beam extragalactic sources just outside the Crab Nebula, with one bright enough to use as a background reference source in our data.

arxiv-2311-00791.title: Where to Deploy an Airborne Relay in Unknown Environments: Feasible Locations for Throughput and LoS Enhancement
arxiv-2311-00791.creator: Juan David Pabon, Matthew C. Valenti, and Xi Yu
arxiv-2311-00791.description: Abstract The deployment of heterogeneous teams of both air and ground mobile assets combines the advantages of mobility, sensing capability, and operational duration when performing complex tasks. Air assets in such teams act to relay information between ground assets but must maintain unblocked paths to enable high-capacity communication modes.

arxiv-2311-10260.title: igraph enables fast and robust network analysis across programming languages
arxiv-2311-10260.creator: Michael Antonov, Gábor Csárdi, Szabolcs Horvát, Kirill Müller, Tamás Nepusz, Daniel Noom, Maëlle Salmon, Vincent Traag, Brooke Foucault Welles, Fabio Zanini
arxiv-2311-10260.description: Abstract Networks or graphs are widely used across the sciences to represent relationships of many kinds. igraph ( https://igraph.org ) is a general-purpose software library for graph construction, analysis, and visualisation, combining fast and robust performance with a low entry barrier. igraph pairs a fast core written in C with beginner-friendly interfaces in Python, R, and Mathematica.

arxiv-2403-16343.title: Percentile Optimization in Wireless Networks— Part II: Beamforming for Cell-Edge Throughput Maximization
arxiv-2403-16343.creator: Ahmad Ali Khan, Raviraj S. Adve
arxiv-2403-16343.description: Abstract Part I of this two-part paper focused on the formulation of percentile problems, complexity analysis, and development of power control algorithms via the quadratic fractional transform (QFT) and logarithmic fractional transform (LFT) for sum-least- q th q^{\mathrm{th}} -percentile (SLqP) rate maximization problems.

arxiv-2407-04784.title: Cavity QED in a High NA Resonator
arxiv-2407-04784.creator: Danial Shadmany ∗, Aishwarya Kumar ∗, Anna Soper, Lukas Palm, Chuan Yin, Henry Ando, Bowen Li, Lavanya Taneja, Matt Jaffe, David I Schuster, Jon Simon
arxiv-2407-04784.description: Abstract From fundamental studies of light-matter interaction to applications in quantum networking & sensing, cavity quantum electrodynamics (QED) provides a platform-crossing toolbox to control interactions between atoms and photons. The coherence of such interactions is determined by the product of the single-pass atomic absorption and the number of photon round-trips.

arxiv-2408-11846.title: Density Matrices for Metaphor Understanding
arxiv-2408-11846.creator: Jasmine Owers, Ekaterina Shutova, Martha Lewis
arxiv-2408-11846.description: Abstract In physics, density matrices are used to represent mixed states, i.e. probabilistic mixtures of pure states. This concept was used to model lexical ambiguity in [ 32 ] . In this paper, we consider metaphor as a type of lexical ambiguity, and examine whether metaphorical meaning can be effectively modelled using mixtures of word senses.

arxiv-2411-09856.title: InvestESG: A multi-agent reinforcement learning benchmark for studying climate investment as a social dilemma
arxiv-2411-09856.creator: Xiaoxuan Hou, Jiayi Yuan, Joel Z. Leibo, Natasha Jaques
arxiv-2411-09856.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Xiaoxuan Hou, Jiayi Yuan, Joel Z. Leibo, Natasha Jaques. InvestESG is a novel multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) benchmark designed to study the impact of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) disclosure mandates on corporate climate investments. The benchmark models an intertemporal social dilemma where companies balance short-term profit losses from climate mitigation efforts and long-term benefits from reducing climate risk, while ESG-conscious investors attempt to influence corporate behavior through their investment decisions.

arxiv-2506-13735.description: Abstract . Prior work has documented widespread racial and ethnic inequities across sectors, such as healthcare, finance, and technology. Across all of these domains, conducting disparity assessments at regular time intervals is critical for surfacing potential biases in decision-making and improving outcomes across demographic groups.

arxiv-2510-12153.title: VeilAudit: Breaking the Deadlock Between Privacy and Accountability Across Blockchains
arxiv-2510-12153.creator: Minhao Qiao, Hai Dong, Iqbal Gondal
arxiv-2510-12153.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Minhao Qiao, Hai Dong, Iqbal Gondal. Cross-chain interoperability in blockchain systems exposes a fundamental tension between user privacy and regulatory accountability. Existing solutions enforce an "all-or-nothing" choice between full anonymity and mandatory identity disclosure, limiting adoption in regulated financial settings. We propose VeilAudit , a cross-chain auditing framework that introduces "Auditor-Only Linkability" (AOL), allowing auditors to link transaction behaviors originating from the same anonymous entity without learning its identity.

pmc-10709154.title: Probable ponatinib-induced papilledema in a patient with acute lymphocytic leukemia
pmc-10709154.creator: Jared A Moon, Eileen C Bowden, Moe H Aung
pmc-10709154.description: PurposePapilledema is a very rare complication of leukemia therapies, and particularly tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) therapy. Targeted oncologic therapies are becoming increasingly popular, so it is increasingly important to report rare adverse effects. We present a case of probable papilledema in the setting of ponatinib therapy for acute lymphoblastic leukemia.

pmc-11605651.description: INTRODUCTIONRecently, CAR-T cell (chimertic antigen receptor T-cell) therapy has been attracting and has shown high therapeutic efficacy, especially in the hematological tumors. In the brain, EGFRv3 or HER2 have been used as antigens, but have yet to show positive results. It is necessary to find antibodies that are more specific and have a therapeutic effect.

pmc-11619629.title: Exploring green solvent systems and enhanced solubility of xanthone in triglyceride-based tricaprin-tricaprylin mixtures with thermodynamic insights
pmc-11619629.creator: Hua Liu, Johnson Stanslas, Jiaoyan Ren, Norhidayah Binti Suleiman, Gun Hean Chong
pmc-11619629.description: This study explores the use of green solvent systems by investigating the solubility and thermodynamic properties of xanthone (1) in triglyceride-based tricaprin (2) and tricaprylin (3) mixtures, aiming to replace traditional organic solvents. The solubility profile exhibited a concave trend, and the highest solubility was observed at a solute-free fraction (x2) of 0.36.

The study begins with structural optimization, which confirms that these compounds maintain stability within cubic crystal structures.

pmc-13356236.title: Impact of Multigene Panel Testing in High‐Risk Uveal Melanoma Patients
pmc-13356236.creator: Lindsey Byrne, Isabella Gray, Kaylee Ramsey, Joseph McElroy, Emma Schreiner, Jenna Wolfe, Olivia B Taylor, Frederick Davidorf, Colleen M Cebulla, Mohamed H Abdel‐Rahman
pmc-13356236.description: Germline genetic testing is increasingly incorporated into the care of patients with uveal melanoma, yet optimal testing strategies remain unclear. This study aimed to evaluate the outcome of germline clinical genetic testing in uveal melanoma (UM) patients who met the National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN) guidelines for genetic testing.

pmc-13482621.title: Factors influencing Somalia household’s willingness to pay renewable energy: employing structural equation modeling
pmc-13482621.creator: Galad Mohamed Barre, Ahmed Hassan Mohamud
pmc-13482621.description: This study used PLS path analysis and structural equation modelling (SEM) to examine the factors influencing Somali households’ willingness to pay for renewable energy. Non-probability purposive sampling was used in a quantitative survey to select respondents from Mogadishu, the capital city of Somalia.

pmc-13554809.title: Phylotranscriptomics Allows Distinguishing Major Gene Flow Events from Incomplete Lineage Sorting in Rapidly Diversifying Mimetic Orchids (Genus Ophrys)
pmc-13554809.creator: Lucas Vandenabeele, Anaïs Gibert, Pascaline Salvado, Roselyne Buscail, Christel Llauro, Michèle Laudié, Hervé Philippe, Joris A M Bertrand
pmc-13554809.description: Ophrys orchids (or bee orchids) provide an outstanding example of a plant adaptive radiation. Over the last 5 million years, this genus has diversified into hundreds of taxa as a result of its unconventional pollination strategy, known as “sexual swindling”.

pmc-13630433.title: Clinical consensus guidelines for the management of Noonan syndrome in Japan
pmc-13630433.creator: Masanobu Kawai, Makiko Tachibana, Hidekazu Ishida, Yoko Aoki, Koji Muroya, Hiroyuki Yamagishi, Kenji Kurosawa, Tsutomu Ogata
pmc-13630433.description: .Noonan syndrome (NS) is a multisystem RASopathy marked by characteristic facies, congenital heart disease, short stature, and variable neurodevelopmental and systemic complications. Although molecular and clinical knowledge has advanced, evidence-based clinical guidance in Japan has been limited. A multidisciplinary committee in pediatric endocrinology, clinical genetics, and pediatric cardiology developed consensus guidelines on diagnosis, comorbidity assessment, treatment, and transitional care.
